info.title: daq
info.description: A tiny, fast CLI that answers "where is this symbol / what calls it" by reading compiled .NET assemblies and their PDBs - no build, no workspace, no decompiler.

commands.name: hover
commands.description: Show the signature(s) of symbols matching <name>.

options.name: --path
options.description: File (glob-capable) or directory to include (repeatable). A directory is scanned non-recursively for .dll files.

options.name: --source-root
options.description: Root directory used to resolve/display source locations. [default: <path>]

options.name: --no-daemon
options.description: Run in-process only; never try or spawn a background daemon. [default: False]

options.name: --daemon-idle-timeout
options.description: Idle timeout in seconds before an auto-spawned daemon exits.

options.name: --kind
options.description: Restrict matches to this member kind: type, method, field, or property.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Restrict matches to this containing namespace.

options.name: --assembly-name
options.description: Restrict matches to this containing assembly name.

options.name: --json
options.description: Output machine-readable JSON instead of human-readable text. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show diagnostic warnings that are hidden by default. [default: False]

options.name: --framework-path
options.description: If the target type isn't indexed, discover and load extra types to resolve it (repeatable). Bare (no value): auto-discover the local machine's matching .NET shared framework (Microsoft.NETCore.App). With one or more values: each value is a directory or an explicit file path - mix freely.

options.name: --include-framework-results
options.description: Include implementers declared only in --framework-path-loaded assemblies in the reported results. By default, --framework-path assemblies are used only to resolve the target type and walk base-type/interface chains; only types from --path are reported as implementers. [default: False]
